seo.title: Dr Ashton Wilson | Osteopath in Newport | Alpha Sports Medicine
seo.description: Meet Dr Ashton Wilson, Newport osteopath, rehabilitation coach and founder of Alpha Sports Medicine, with a special interest in hypermobility, EDS and HSD.

hero.portraitAlt: Dr Ashton Wilson, osteopath and founder of Alpha Sports Medicine
hero.heading: Dr Ashton Wilson
hero.role: Osteopath, strength and rehabilitation coach, educator and founder of Alpha Sports Medicine.
hero.intro: Ashton works with people navigating complex musculoskeletal concerns, sporting injuries and hypermobility. Her approach combines clear explanations, hands-on osteopathic care and progressive rehabilitation.

intro.heading: Thoughtful care for complex presentations
paragraphs: Ashton begins by understanding the whole picture: what you are feeling, what you have tried, how you move and what you want to return to. Treatment is explained clearly and shaped with you, not handed to you as a generic plan.

Her background in strength and conditioning helps connect treatment in the clinic with the capacity you need outside it. The aim is to help you understand your body, build confidence and make useful progress towards your goals.

interestsIntro: Care is always based on the individual assessment rather than a diagnosis alone.

interests.title: Hypermobility, EDS and HSD
interests.copy: Support for joint instability, persistent pain, fatigue and building capacity in a way that respects a hypermobile body.

interests.title: Sport and rehabilitation
interests.copy: A practical path from pain or injury back to training, performance and the activities that matter to you.

interests.title: Foot, ankle and jaw concerns
interests.copy: Assessment and care for recurring foot and ankle issues, TMJ discomfort, jaw tension and related movement patterns.

qualifications: Bachelor of Biomedical Science — Anatomy and Physiology
ASCA Level 1 Strength and Conditioning Coach

personal.heading: The person behind the practitioner
personal.copy: Outside work, Ashton enjoys running, hiking, gym training, travelling and boardgames with friends. She is also a committed Melbourne Storm and North Melbourne supporter—and usually has a book, podcast or research paper on hypermobility close by.

closing.heading: Book an appointment with Ashton
closing.copy: Choose a Newport or online appointment, or call the clinic if you would like help deciding whether Ashton is the right practitioner for you.
